findings.title: PDF QR PNG fallback is factually wrong and depends on an undeclared package
findings.location: Technology Stack (QR); QR rendering strategy; PermitService::qrDataUri(); Response-to-Findings #3 / NIT #5
findings.problem: The design says simple-qrcode's PNG writer requires GD and that endroid/qr-code is an added composer dependency. Both are wrong against the repo: bacon-qr-code ships only Eps/Imagick/Svg backends (no GD PNG backend), so PNG via simple-qrcode requires imagick, which this machine lacks (GD:yes IMAGICK:no); and endroid/qr-code is neither in composer.json require nor in vendor/. The documented fallback is non-functional in the target environment.
findings.fix: Either (a) declare endroid/qr-code in composer.json require and specify qrDataUri()'s PNG branch uses endroid (GD-based), correcting the imagick-vs-GD prose; or (b) drop the PNG fallback and make the baseline SVG-data-URI only, justified by the verified presence of dompdf/php-svg-lib. In both cases remove the false 'simple-qrcode PNG requires GD' sentence.

findings.title: Permit REVOKED status has no write path
findings.problem: REVOKED is a defined permit status classified by /verify and recordable in qr_verifications, but no route, controller, or PermitService method ever sets a permit to REVOKED. The branch is unreachable dead state. Revocation is not a brief requirement.
findings.fix: Either note that revocation is out of scope and REVOKED is a reserved forward-compat value, or add PermitService::revoke() plus POST /bplo/permits/{permit}/revoke with an audit entry.

findings.title: Service DTOs referenced but not defined
findings.problem: GatewayResult and SmsResult are used in signatures with no fields defined, leaving the gateway/verify success-failure contract to interpretation; FeeBreakdown is only partly pinned.
findings.fix: Define each as a small readonly DTO (e.g. GatewayResult { bool $ok; string $status; ?string $reference; array $raw; }, SmsResult { string $status; ?string $error; }) and state PaymentService::verify() keys PAID/FAILED on GatewayResult::$ok.

findings.title: Admin 'manage roles and permissions' maps only to role assignment
findings.location: Roles & Authorization; Admin route map /admin/users; brief requirement C
findings.problem: The brief lists 'Manage roles and permissions'; the design implements a fixed 3-value role string with admin role assignment and no permissions-management surface. Defensible scope reading, but left implicit.
findings.fix: Add a sentence stating permissions are fixed, policy-encoded per role and admin management is limited to assigning one of three roles plus account activation/deactivation; no dynamic permission editing in scope.

findings.title: /track second factor 'email or last name' is ambiguous for last name
findings.location: Public route map POST /track; TrackingLookupRequest; track page section
findings.problem: There is no last_name column; the snapshot stores applicant_name as a single string, and the matching rule for 'last name' against a full-name field (exact/substring/case) is unspecified.
findings.fix: Specify the rule, e.g. verifier matches if it equals applications.email (case-insensitive) OR is a case-insensitive substring of applications.applicant_name; validate verifier as required|string|max:255.
